document.content:
# Portfolio Review — Week 13 (March 17-23, 2026)

## Executive Summary

Massive architecture shift this week. Otto designed "Nuke" — a complete Kira rebuild with 11 approved design docs. This is a bet-the-farm infrastructure play that directly conflicts with the 60/30/10 ratio. Revenue execution continued on IAM outreach but Oopuo website remains blocked. ZenithCred website fixed but pitch deck needs live pilot data.

## Company-by-Company

### IAM (InterActiveMove) — REVENUE ⚡
- **Status:** Active outreach. Wave 1 Tier 1 emails prepared for top 5 kindergarten chains (Partou 1039 locations, Humankind, Babilou, Kindergarden, CompaNanny — 2000+ locations combined)
- **Progress:** Day 5 sales task sent (Kind & Co Ludens, 423 locations). All 5 Tier 1 emails sent. Follow-ups due Day 10 for non-responders.
- **Risk:** No responses tracked yet. No CRM (HubSpot form still broken on Oopuo site).
- **ROI:** Highest. One enterprise deal = transformative revenue.

### Oopuo — REVENUE 🟡
- **Status:** Website live but contact form BROKEN (HubSpot formId placeholder since March 18). Every day this stays broken = lost leads.
- **Progress:** GA4 integrated, logo updated, sitemap/robots done, HubSpot funnel designed.
- **Blocker:** Otto needs to provide HubSpot formId. This has been flagged 4+ times across 4 days.

### ZenithCred — FUNDING 🟡
- **Status:** Website on zenith.zenithcred.com. Pitch Deck v2.0 finalized with "Pilot Readiness" framing.
- **Progress:** Cloudflare/SEO fixes done. Investor one-pager exists.
- **Risk:** No active investor outreach visible this week. Seed round €1.1M target with no momentum.

### Chimera — INFRASTRUCTURE 🔵
- **Status:** Whitepaper v0.2 consolidated. Architecture docs exist.
- **Note:** Nuke architecture positions Chimera as the core long-term bet. No near-term revenue.

### CuttingEdge — REVENUE 🟡
- **Status:** Strategy and UX docs exist. No visible activity this week.

### Abura — REVENUE 🟡
- **Status:** Positioning decision (Affordable vs True Luxury) still unresolved. Blocking wholesale catalog.

### SentinAgro — PLANNED ⚪
- **Status:** No activity. Pitch deck and strategy docs exist but no execution.

## Week Assessment

**Revenue work: ~30%** (IAM outreach active, but Oopuo blocked)
**Infrastructure work: ~60%** (Nuke architecture dominated the week)
**Funding work: ~10%** (ZenithCred website fixes only)

**This is inverted from the 60/30/10 target.** The Nuke session was 3+ hours of pure infrastructure design. While strategic, it produced zero revenue progress.

## March MRR Target: $700
- **Current visible MRR:** Unknown / not tracked
- **Days remaining in March:** 8
- **Assessment:** At risk. No closed deals visible. IAM outreach just started.
